name: ubiquitous-language
title: Ubiquitous Language
description: Extract canonical terminology so future planning, discussion, and implementation stay aligned.
command_description: Scan the repo and produce a canonical shared vocabulary.
prompt: Scan code, docs, tests, schemas, and configs to derive docs/ai/ubiquitous_language.md. Capture canonical terms, definitions grounded in the repo, synonyms, overloaded words, and vague phrases to avoid. Prefer repo truth over generic software jargon.
